title: The lane verdict prints the session's BLOCKER line
body:
Why: lane t-nfjxshj ended twice with the session final line `BLOCKER: sandbox mounts scripts/, .claude/ and .agents/ read-only` but the lane verdict printed only `dirty tree`; the lead had to open the transcript to learn why.
Outcome: when the session result text ends with a BLOCKER line, the lane verdict prints it (first 200 chars) and exits with a distinct code; dirty tree stays for sessions without one.
Proof: test/cli/lane-run.test.ts on a verbatim capture of a claude -p result whose result field ends with BLOCKER; npm run fast PASS.
